surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the sequential adsorption and reaction of yttrium and zirconium precursors with ozone. The Y(thd)3/O3 and Zr(thd)4/O3 cycles are used to deposit YSZ films. The mechanism includes the formation of surface hydroxyl groups and the subsequent reaction with the metal precursors.
